title: fix(studio): action editor grants a sandboxed-JS script body its capabilities
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbBnAkqesoEyqbMPT6kx6h1X)_

Fixes #29181

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:Studio 动作编辑器里「运行脚本 + Sandboxed JS (L2)」的函数体下方新增「能力授权」勾选列表(api.read / api.write 等),与钩子编辑器共用同一个控件。
- **为什么改**:动作脚本读写数据需要 `body.capabilities`,编辑器原先没有任何入口,作者发布的动作每次点击都被 403 拒绝,只能改原始元数据。
- **风险与回滚**:纯前端编辑器改动,不动 spec 与运行时;钩子编辑器换成共享控件后渲染与写入不变(26726 原测试未改动全绿)。回滚即撤销本 PR。
- **先看**:`ScriptCapabilitiesField.tsx`(新共享控件);`ActionDefaultInspector.tsx` 中 `bodyLanguageOf(body) === 'js'` 那一段;`HookDefaultInspector.tsx` 替换处。
- **两分钟验证**:`cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/ActionDefaultInspector.capabilities-29181.test.tsx`,预期 6/6 通过。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **New `ScriptCapabilitiesField.tsx`** (module-private, beside the inspectors, no barrel re-export): the grant list of a sandboxed-JS body. One checkbox per `HookBodyCapability` token, read from the spec enum in its order, each naming the `ctx` call it unlocks; a stored token the enum does not list stays visible and flagged; unticking the last grant writes `[]`, the spec default. The host passes the hint key, so each editor says when a refusal happens.
- **`ActionDefaultInspector.tsx`**: renders that control under the script body when the body's language is `js`. Writes go through the existing single body writer (`writeScriptBody`), so `language` is kept and a switch to an expression body still drops `capabilities` with the other L2-only keys. An expression body shows no control.
- **`HookDefaultInspector.tsx`**: its inline grant list is replaced by the shared control with the same test id, label, hint, flag and write. Its rendered output and writes are unchanged; `HookDefaultInspector.capabilities-26726.test.tsx` is untouched and green.
- **Spec enum check**: `ActionSchema.body` is `HookBodySchema`, whose L2 arm is `ScriptBodySchema` with `capabilities: z.array(HookBodyCapability)`, so the action body uses the same enum as the hook body, and the control is shared rather than duplicated. `packages/spec` is not edited.
- **i18n**: one new Studio-namespace row, `engine.inspector.action.capabilitiesHint` (en, zh), because the hook hint says the call "throws when the hook runs". The label and the unknown-token flag reuse the hook rows. The Studio namespace is not part of the built `locales` surface, so the claim's `Clause-②: no` stands.
- **Changeset**: `.changeset/29181-action-script-capabilities.md`, `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/i18n` patch.

## Tests

New `ActionDefaultInspector.capabilities-29181.test.tsx` (6 cases), driving the real inspector in a host that merges patches the way `ObjectActionsPanel` does, sending the held draft through a JSON round trip and parsing it with the spec's `ActionSchema`:

1. The card path: New action, "Run a script", "Sandboxed JS (L2)", type a body that updates the record: the control shows exactly `HookBodyCapability.options`; ticking `api.write` writes `body.capabilities: ['api.write']` and the action parses.
2. An expression body shows no control, and its edits never write the key.
3. A stored JS action without `capabilities` loads with nothing ticked, rendering writes nothing, and a source edit leaves the body without the key.
4. An existing grant shows ticked, a new grant is written in spec order, clearing the last writes `[]`; each step parses.
5. Switching a granted JS body to expression drops the grant and hides the control; the save parses.
6. The hint and label read in the designer locale (zh).

## Acceptance notes

- **Real Studio run (author, publish, click, 200 instead of 403): NOT MEASURED.** Staging it needs a full build, a Console build and a showcase server; the runtime half (the sandbox honouring a granted `api.write`) is existing behaviour this PR does not touch. Standing in: case 1 above, which proves the editor writes the exact `body.capabilities` the runtime's refusal prescribes and that `ActionSchema` accepts it.
- `BODY_KEYS_BY_LANGUAGE` in the action inspector stays written out (its comment keeps the spec body schema out of the first load). The shared control imports `HookBodyCapability` from `@objectstack/spec/data`, which `HookDefaultInspector` already imported in the same registration module (`inspectors/index.ts` registers both), so no new spec module reaches any chunk.
